summary: @femedtech and we did put in a few issues in December with @wikipedia hoping they add IndieAuth, so if a library did provide patrons with a domain they could log in without needing an email address or phone, just use a url.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @femedtech and we did put in a few issues in December with @wikipedia hoping they add IndieAuth, so if a library did provide patrons with a domain they could log in without needing an email address or phone, just use a url.
